title: korblox R6 a headless
script:
-- LocalScript: Korblox + Headless + Orador da Morte (perna esquerda)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

-- IDs reais
local KORBLOX_MESH_ID = "rbxassetid://101851696"
local KORBLOX_TEXTURE_ID = "rbxassetid://101851254"
local HEADLESS_MESH_ID = "rbxassetid://123456789" -- Headless hipotético
local ORADOR_LEFT_LEG_MESH_ID = "rbxassetid://139607673"
local ORADOR_LEFT_LEG_TEXTURE_ID = "" -- pode deixar vazio se não tiver texture

-- Função para aplicar SpecialMesh
local function applyMesh(part, meshId, textureId, scale)
    if not part then return end
    local mesh = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
    if mesh then mesh:Destroy() end

    local specialMesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
    specialMesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
    specialMesh.MeshId = meshId
    specialMesh.TextureId = textureId or ""
    specialMesh.Scale = scale or Vector3.new(1,1,1)
    specialMesh.Parent = part
end

-- Aplica Headless
local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
if head then
    applyMesh(head, HEADLESS_MESH_ID, "", Vector3.new(1,1,1))
end

-- Aplica Korblox na perna direita
local rightLeg = character:FindFirstChild("Right Leg") or character:FindFirstChild("RightLowerLeg")
applyMesh(rightLeg, KORBLOX_MESH_ID, KORBLOX_TEXTURE_ID, Vector3.new(1,1,1))

-- Aplica Orador da Morte na perna esquerda
local leftLeg = character:FindFirstChild("Left Leg") or character:FindFirstChild("LeftLowerLeg")
applyMesh(leftLeg, ORADOR_LEFT_LEG_MESH_ID, ORADOR_LEFT_LEG_TEXTURE_ID, Vector3.new(1,1,1))
